title: (No AI) Please stop asking me when the AI bubble will pop
author: Elizabeth Lopatto
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2302813651.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Emmanuel Roman, chief executive officer of Pacific Investment Management Co. (Pimco), during the Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit in Hong Kong, China, on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. | Bloomberg via Getty Images

People, including on this staff, keep asking me with varying degrees of excitement or trepidation when the AI bubble will burst. I'll tell you what I tell them: If I knew that, I would make a life-changing bet on the market, levered up as far as I could, and then, after I made my money, go retire on a beach somewhere. Maybe run a cat sanctuary, who knows.

What I can tell you is that I read with interest a story in _Bloomberg_ this morning: "[Wall Street CEOs, Big Money Managers Divided Over AI Risks](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-03/wall-street-ceos-big-global-money-managers-debate-ai-risks)." The story itself is a roundup of stuff said at the 2026 Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit in Hong Kong. Here's what caught my attentio …

title: (No AI) Those Jeff Bezos hair transplant photos are very fake
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![Two photos. one showing Jason Statham on the left, and Jeff Bezos on the right, both of which have been edited with hair.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Fake-Jeff-Bezos-Jason-Statham-hair-photo-edits.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

These edits of Jason Statham (left) and Jeff Bezos are a bit jarring, but that’s sort of the point. | Image: The Verge

Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and actor Jason Statham have a distinctive feature in common: They're both famously bald, and that definitely hasn't changed in the last few days. However, there are [some images](https://x.com/kvng_chi/status/2117300489515868273) of the two men [circulating around X](https://x.com/i/trending/2117386539840012574), [Threads](https://www.threads.com/@mjg5x5/post/DfSEg4BEYf-?xmt=AQG0Z0SHWX_7CdbsWnT9-8DsZCvTky83tg4v2we48vgpNa-58Dzz_mwjXl3wDiWueAH3t7qJ&slof=1), and [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/jamellebouie.net/post/3mzgcqghxbk2s) in which they both have substantially more hair than their usual shaved look, which in Bezos' case appears to be _very_ freshly transplanted. It's all just photo editing fakery, AI or otherwise.

It's unclear [how viral](https://www.threads.com/@9six7/post/DfQyiH8EcmO/looks-very-natural-said-everyone-on-his-payroll/) these [posts are](https://x.com/semtinmuhabiri/status/2117226307776127241), but they're prevalent enough that a few members of the _Verge_ team have encountered them in their social media feeds. Some people who shared them claimed …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1025745/fake-jeff-bezos-hair-replacement-photos-debunk)
